note: Curated 'Voice of the user' signals for the dashboard rotator. Each entry pairs a significant research signal (pattern) found across the Helio first-impression comprehension tests with the single most compelling REAL verbatim that represents it. Quotes are participant words — never paraphrase or edit them. Re-curate each cycle; if this file is absent or has no patterns, the rotator falls back to the harvested quote pool. Source: Helio first-impression tests, July 2026 cycle (EDC Blueprint, Accelerate Live Stream, Contextual Intelligence, 1touch, Future of Storage).

patterns.signal: The assessment framing is starting to land — some visitors now describe EDC by what you do (run an assessment), not just by storage.
patterns.quote: It emphasizes enterprise data and allows one to do an assessment.

patterns.signal: But “storage” is still the default first read for EDC — the enterprise-data-management message hasn’t fully broken through.
patterns.quote: Is a platform where cloud data are sold.

patterns.signal: Visitors hesitate at the ask — the page invites an assessment before establishing why it’s worth their time.
patterns.quote: Why would you assume I'd start an assessment straight away?

patterns.signal: The live-stream page blurred “promoting an event” vs. “watch it now” — the fix (a dominant Watch Live action + live-state cues) shipped before launch.
patterns.quote: I am not sure if this promotes an event or if it enables me to view it on stream.

patterns.signal: When the value is concrete, it lands cleanly — visitors can restate the “fragmented data → contextual intelligence” promise in their own words.
patterns.quote: It appears to be a platform that organizes and enriches company data so it can be used more effectively by AI, turning fragmented information into contextual intelligence for business decision-making.

patterns.signal: Left abstract, the value prop inverts — some read the offer backwards (“AI into data” instead of data into AI-ready intelligence).
patterns.quote: This product is a technology product that transforms AI into data.

patterns.signal: Clarity arrives on scroll, not at first glance — the 10-second read of the storage story doesn’t land immediately.
patterns.quote: The information is clear once you scroll down the website but not at the first glance.
